title: Dependency-Aware Build Planner
goal: Deliver the dependency-aware build planner through this interactive coding session. Incorporate every steering message and staged requirement file, preserve supplied tests, and keep the implementation maintainable and standard-library only. Keep the goal active until the user sends `REQUIREMENTS LOCKED`. Then run the complete suite, fix all failures, call `await goal.complete()`, and respond exactly `BUILD PLAN GOAL COMPLETE`.

prompts.text: Start the active goal. Read TASK.md, run the baseline suite, and implement the current planner requirements. Expect live steering and later product pivots. Do not complete the goal before REQUIREMENTS LOCKED.
Steering update: keep ordering deterministic, preserve caller data, and make cycle and missing-module diagnostics useful. Continue current work but keep the goal active for product input.
Product pivot: I added PIVOT.md and tests/test_pivot.py. Add dependency-aware incremental rebuild planning while preserving all existing behavior. Run the expanded suite and keep the goal active.
Follow-up: I added FOLLOWUP.md and tests/test_followup.py. Add explainability and the JSON CLI exactly as specified. Run the expanded suite, but wait for the final lock.
REQUIREMENTS LOCKED. Run the complete suite, fix every failure while editing only buildplan/, call `await goal.complete()`, and respond exactly `BUILD PLAN GOAL COMPLETE`.
